name: Anika Sharma
bio: Met during freshman orientation at university. We backpacked through Southeast Asia together after graduation. She's now a UX designer in Berlin.

name: Marcus Webb
bio: Former manager who became a genuine friend. We play pickup basketball every few weekends and he gives great career advice over coffee.

name: Lena Hoffmann
bio: We grew up on the same street and have stayed close despite living in different countries. Monthly video calls and an annual trip to somewhere neither of us has been.

name: Daniel Osei
bio: My college roommate for three years. We bonded over jazz and late-night philosophy debates. He's a high school music teacher in Accra now and we've been terrible at keeping in touch.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Met at a cooking class two years ago and we've been testing restaurants around the city ever since. She introduced me to her whole social circle.

name: Ryan Callahan
bio: Best friend from high school. We drifted during college but reconnected at a reunion. Now mostly catch up over online games and the occasional visit when he's in town.

name: Yuki Tanaka
bio: We met at a tech conference and realized we lived 10 minutes apart. Now we go on trail hikes every month and vent about industry nonsense together.

name: Samuel Adeyemi
bio: Co-founded a failed startup together right after college — one of the best experiences of my life despite the outcome. Still brainstorm ideas over calls and genuinely root for each other.
